title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.basis: Visually checked ventricular landmarks on original PDF 520
fields.reason: Successive ventricular peak spacings: 95 px, 91 px, 90 px, 91 px, 90 px, 90 px, 91 px. Descriptive judgment from visible spacing, not a validated diagnostic threshold.

fields.basis: Course-standard 25 mm/s assumption; 150 independently detected small-square intervals across 738 pixels
fields.reason: Mean R–R estimate 81.0 bpm; six-second count estimate 80 bpm. All seconds/bpm depend on course-standard 25 mm/s. Count estimate assumes 150 small squares = 6 seconds; endpoint phase and partial complexes affect it. On irregular strips the count estimate is not a stable instantaneous rate. Mean RR describes only intervals between observed peaks.

fields.value: Candidate P-wave observation: Very small upright humps recur before predominantly negative complexes. Their excursion is comparable to local baseline/line thickness, so visible P-like morphology is retained without assigning atrial identity. A further small right-edge hump is not paired with an enclosed next complex.

fields.basis: Original PDF page 520; independently reconciled endpoint bands and horizontal grid; assumes course 25 mm/s (0.04 s per small square), not a verified per-strip speed
fields.reason: Propose broad conditional envelope: each dominant negative complex has a rapid onset and a bounded recovery to a nearly flat shelf. Offset band includes the gradual final recovery, not a nadir-to-nadir or peak interval. Assumes course 25 mm/s and correct component identity/boundaries. Envelopes describe measurement uncertainty, not actual duration variability. Are the tiny pre-complex humps true P waves? This envelope includes reader and endpoint uncertainty; it is not a confidence interval, normal/abnormal classification, or proof of beat-to-beat physiological variation. Qualified ECG educator review is outstanding.

fields.value: Repeated predominantly negative complexes, with small intervening deflections. Negative polarity alone does not establish origin or diagnosis.
fields.basis: New provisional descriptive review, not a publisher answer or definitive rhythm diagnosis

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.
pr unresolved: Hold PR: recurring humps are too low amplitude to separate confidently from baseline ripples; their candidate onset can be bracketed but atrial identity is unresolved.

P-wave text is a provisional description, not validated atrial identity. PR remains unresolved with no numerical answer. QRS has an unvalidated conditional endpoint envelope for selected complexes. Validated electrical boundaries and qualified educator adjudication remain outstanding.
Calibration assumes the course’s 25 mm/s convention, not speed metadata printed on each strip. Peak uncertainty is approximately ±2 source pixels, excluding errors in identifying the waveform.
